text: Sabko pata chal jaata hai | ki tumhari _post_ | *AI* ne likhi hai.
Toh chalo, *Claude* ko | sikhate hain ki woh bilkul | _tumhari_ _tarah_ likhe.
Woh _generic_ isliye lagta hai, | kyunki usne tumhara | likha hua kabhi | _padha_ hi nahi.
Toh ek *folder* banao, | aur usme apni likhi hui | *das* _posts_ daal do.
Yeh folder *Claude* _Code_ mein kholo, | aur yeh _prompt_ paste karo.
Woh saari posts padhega | aur ek file banayega: | _voice.md._ | Tumhare _rules._ | Tum kaise *shuru* karte ho, | kaise *khatam* karte ho, | kaun se words tum | kabhi use _nahi_ karte.
Aur sabse _important_ line yeh hai: | *learn* *my* _rules,_ | *not* *my* _phrases._ | Yeh nahi likhi, | toh woh bas tumhari | purani posts _copy_ karega.
Pehle woh likhta tha: | "In today's _fast-paced_ world." | Ab? | "I quit on a *Tuesday.* | Nobody _noticed._"
Kuch bhi _off_ lage, | *seedha* bol do, | aur bolo ki yeh | _fix_ save kar le.
Har post thodi aur | _tumhari_ jaisi lagegi.
Dono _prompts_ caption mein hain. | *Save* kar lo, | aaj raat _try_ karo.
